noun_definition: Error message refers to a notification that appears when an error occurs, which in this context does not close with a single click when the address dropdown is open.
Click refers to the action of pressing a mouse button or tapping on a touchscreen to interact with user interface elements, such as buttons or dropdowns, within the application.
Address dropdown refers to the user interface element that appears when clicking on the address input field, allowing users to select or enter an address.
